data.name: BackupHeader
data.value: Back up a file to paper

data.name: BackupIntro
data.value: Choose a small critical file — a private key, a password database — and generate a PDF of QR codes to print. The printed sheets are the backup; this application is only a convenience for making and reading them.

data.name: BackupChunkSizeSmall
data.value: Small — 512 bytes per code, sparsest modules, easiest to scan

data.name: BackupChunkSizeLarge
data.value: Large — 1536 bytes per code, densest modules, fewest pages

data.name: BackupChunkSizeNote
data.value: This setting applies to the current session only — it is not remembered between runs.

data.name: BackupEstimateFormat
data.comment: {0} = number of QR codes, metadata code included. {1} = number of A4 pages.

data.name: BackupLargeInputWarningFormat
data.value: This file needs about {0} pages. Printing and re-scanning that many sheets takes a while — a larger barcode density, or a smaller file, would cut it down.

data.name: BackupEstimateFailedFormat
data.value: This file cannot be laid out on A4 with the current settings: {0}
data.comment: {0} = the reason reported by the layout.

data.name: BackupDefaultPdfNameFormat
data.comment: {0} = the name of the file being backed up.

data.name: BackupSuccessFormat
data.value: Saved {0} — {1} codes across {2} pages. Print it, check that every symbol came out sharp, and store the sheets somewhere safe.
data.comment: {0} = destination name. {1} = number of codes. {2} = number of pages.

data.name: BackupReadFailedFormat
data.value: The file could not be read: {0}

data.name: BackupGenerateFailedFormat
data.value: The PDF could not be produced: {0}

data.name: BackupWriteFailedFormat
data.value: The PDF could not be written: {0}

data.name: RecoverIntro
data.value: Import scans or photographs of the printed pages, or type a code by hand. Codes may arrive in any order and from either source; repeats are harmless.

data.name: RecoverDropHint
data.value: …or drop image files anywhere on this page.

data.name: RecoverManualHint
data.value: Paste or type one or more codes. Line breaks and lower case are fine.

data.name: RecoverNothingYet
data.value: No code has been read yet.

data.name: RecoverMetadataMissing
data.value: The metadata code (index 0) is still missing. Without it the file has no name, no expected size and no hash to check against.

data.name: RecoverChunksFormat
data.comment: {0} = codes received. {1} = codes the backup is made of.

data.name: RecoverChunksUnknown
data.value: Unknown until the first code is read

data.name: RecoverMissingNothingKnown
data.value: Nothing known to be missing yet

data.name: RecoverMissingOverflowFormat
data.comment: {0} = the first missing indexes, comma separated. {1} = how many are not listed.

data.name: RecoverCompleteHint
data.value: Every code is in. Rebuild the file to check it against the recorded hash.

data.name: RecoverSavedFormat
data.value: Saved {0}. Its SHA-256 matches the backup — the recovery is intact.

data.name: RecoverSavedUnverifiedFormat
data.value: Saved {0} unverified. Its hash does not match the backup, so these bytes are not provably the file that was backed up.

data.name: RecoverImageNoCodesFormat
data.value: {0}: readable, but no QR code was found on it.

data.name: RecoverImageScannedFormat
data.comment: {0} = the image's file name. {1} = codes found. {2} = codes the session did not already hold.

data.name: RecoverImageFailedFormat
data.comment: {0} = the image's file name. {1} = the underlying error message.

data.name: RecoverManualEmpty
data.value: There is no code text to add.

data.name: RecoverManualNoCodesFound
data.value: That text holds no code — every code starts with EHC1:.

data.name: RecoverWriteFailedFormat
data.value: The recovered file could not be written: {0}

data.name: RecoverMismatchWarningFormat
data.value: The rebuilt file's SHA-256 is {0}, but the backup recorded {1}. These bytes are not the file that was backed up — save them only if you understand what you are looking at.
data.comment: {0} = the hash of the rebuilt bytes. {1} = the hash recorded in the backup.

data.name: CodeDuplicateFormat
data.value: Code {0} was already in — nothing changed.

data.name: CodeBadCrcFormat
data.value: Code {0} failed its own checksum. Re-scan or retype that one code.

data.name: CodeConflictFormat
data.value: Code {0} contradicts a code already read; one of the two is damaged.

data.name: CodeWrongBackupFormat
data.value: Code {0} belongs to backup {1}, not to this one. It was ignored.
data.comment: {0} = the barcode index. {1} = the foreign backup ID.

data.name: CodeMalformed
data.value: That is not an Enigma.HardCopy code.

data.name: CodeMalformedFormat
data.value: Code {0} is not a valid Enigma.HardCopy code.

data.name: AssemblyIncomplete
data.value: Some codes are still missing — see what is still needed.

data.name: AssemblyEncryptionUnsupported
data.value: This backup is marked as encrypted, which this version cannot undo. It was written by a newer build.

data.name: AssemblyDecompressionFailed
data.value: The codes are each intact but do not form the compressed file the metadata describes — the likeliest cause is a mistyped index.

data.name: AssemblyHashMismatch
data.value: The file was rebuilt, but its hash does not match the backup.

data.name: AssemblyVerified
data.value: The file was rebuilt and its SHA-256 matches the backup.

data.name: DialogChooseFileTitle
data.value: Choose the file to back up
